M12 — 2026-10-13
In a driven lane, `node scripts/<x>.mjs` needs approval, even though `node --version`, `npx vitest run` and `npm test` run. A measurement script over the operator's transcripts therefore cannot run inside a lane; the operator runs it, or the run's --allow names it.
